evidence_status: Preregistered design and software-audit contract only; no model experiment has been run.

secondary_benchmark.interpretation: protected code diagnostic only; never a differentiable gate loss
target code diagnostic only; never a differentiable gate loss

split_assignment.tie_breaking: not applicable because each cluster is mapped independently
split_assignment.sealed_benchmark_rule: Registered benchmark roles are never passed through this split.
split_assignment.small_partition_rule: A source with an empty required partition blocks the pilot; boundaries are never moved after observing content or labels.
split_assignment.cross_source_cluster_rule: A semantic cluster crossing source or protected-role boundaries is excluded in full before assignment.

gate_semantics.score_use: All target and protected planning losses use only their score partitions.
gate_semantics.gate_use: The post-selection gate uses one fresh with-replacement block from each protected capability's gate partition.
gate_semantics.audit_use: Target and protected endpoint losses use each capability's untouched audit partition.
gate_semantics.clipping: Gate example-average NLL is clipped to the preregistered bound only after the capability and partition are selected; audit NLL is not clipped.

limitations: The capability labels are operational dataset slices, not exhaustive constructs or safety guarantees.
Hash assignment prevents outcome-dependent split movement but does not establish semantic independence; that depends on the separately reviewed clustering audit.
The split proportions are digest-mass intervals, not forced exact row-count percentages.
